input.quote: 2.2 Internal Use License. Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, Commerce One grants to Corio a nonexclusive, nontransferable (except in accordance with Section 14.1 of this Agreement), royalty-free, fully paid up, perpetual right and license in the Territory to reproduce, install and use additional copies of the Software and Software tools and utilities, subject to any restrictions placed on the Commerce One by third party software providers, in machine executable object code for (i) Corio's internal business operations and (ii) production, testing, development, upgrade, reporting and training.
input.rationale: The grant is otherwise favourable to us: the hosting licence in Section 2.1 is "perpetual and irrevocable", the internal-use licence in Section 2.2 is perpetual and fully paid up, sublicensing to Customers is expressly permitted, and the nontransferability carve-out to Section 14.1 permits assignment to a successor in a merger, acquisition or asset sale. The one gap against our preferred position is scope of licensed users: no licence rights run to Corio's affiliates or to contractors acting on Corio's behalf (the word "Affiliate" does not appear anywhere in the agreement), and the internal-use licence is limited to "Corio's internal business operations". We therefore propose a short new Section 2.11 extending the Section 2 licences to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, with Corio remaining responsible for their compliance.

proposal.summary: Extend the Section 2 licences to Corio's Affiliates and to contractors acting on Corio's behalf
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a short provision extending the Section 2 licences to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf (with us remaining responsible for their compliance), since our playbook requires licence scope to cover affiliates and contractors and the current grant is limited to Corio alone. If Commerce One prefers, we can accept coverage of Affiliates upon written notice as a fallback.

ops.text: 2.11 Affiliates and Contractors. The licenses granted to Corio under this Section 2 extend to Corio's Affiliates and to contractors acting on Corio's behalf, provided that Corio shall remain responsible for their compliance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement. For purposes of this Agreement, "AFFILIATE" means any entity that controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with Corio, where "control" means direct or indirect ownership of more than fifty percent (50%) of the voting interests of such entity.
